python3 - <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root = ET.parse('/conf/config.xml').getroot()
def show(node, prefix=''):
    for child in list(node):
        path = prefix + '/' + child.tag
        if child.text and child.text.strip() and child.tag in {
            'if','enable','ipaddr','subnet','gateway','descr','type','interface',
            'ipprotocol','protocol','target','local-port','destination','source',
            'network','address','port','disabled','log','quick','direction',
            'natreflection','associated-rule-id','mode','from','to'
        }:
            print('%s=%s' % (path, child.text.strip()))
        show(child, path)
print('--- interfaces ---')
show(root.find('interfaces') or ET.Element('none'), '/interfaces')
print('--- gateways ---')
show(root.find('gateways') or ET.Element('none'), '/gateways')
print('--- filter ---')
show(root.find('filter') or ET.Element('none'), '/filter')
print('--- nat ---')
show(root.find('nat') or ET.Element('none'), '/nat')
PY
